payload.headline: Project cycle 54.5% complete: budget field, project manager role, and supplier invoice checks failed
what_went_wrong: Check 3 likely failed: project budget (354050 kr) was never set on the project — POST /project body lacked a 'budget' or 'projectBudget' field.

Check 4 likely failed: Arne Brekke was set as projectManager on the project object but the scoring may check a dedicated project member/role endpoint (e.g. POST /project/projectActivity or member role assignment).
Check 5 likely failed: supplier cost registered via generic ledger voucher instead of a proper supplier invoice (POST /supplierInvoice or /incomingInvoice), which the scorer likely checks for.
First voucher attempt failed with 422 (supplier missing on posting), wasting one API call before the corrected retry succeeded.
what_worked: Timesheet entries for both Arne (43h) and Solveig (52h) created successfully and passed checks.
Customer invoice created and passed scoring checks; order/orderline flow worked correctly.
what_to_try_next: Add budget to POST /project body: include 'budget': 354050 or 'projectBudgetAmount': 354050 — inspect the project schema first to find the correct field name.
Use POST /supplierInvoice (or /incomingInvoice) with proper supplier, amount, and project linkage instead of a raw ledger voucher for the 54900 kr supplier cost.
Verify project manager assignment passes scoring by checking if a separate POST /project/projectMember or role endpoint is needed beyond setting projectManager in the project body.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account called twice (two separate calls for account 6900 and 2400) — could be combined into one call with query params.

POST /ledger/voucher first attempt (422 error) — could be avoided by inspecting schema before posting to know supplier field is required on all postings.
